bugs.description: INJECTED (return-value-dropped): Return value dropped in an exported function; callers still use the result. `return <value>` replaced by an empty return in `parse` (callers still consume the result). Mutated src/utils/cookie.ts:82: `return {}` -> `return;`. The bug manifests in src/helper/cookie/index.ts:39: `const obj = parse(cookie, finalKey)`.
